(()=>{const log=document.querySelector('.assistant-conversation[role="log"]')||document.querySelector('.assistant-conversation');if(!log)throw Error('No assistant conversation log to read');const rows=[...log.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(n=>n.children.length===0&&(n.textContent||'').trim());const text=log.textContent||'';return JSON.stringify({domLeafRows:rows.length,mentionsSentinel:text.includes('${SENTINEL}'),head:text.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,400)})})()
